text:
maya: Hey folks — thinking of a Weeknight Trivia + Tapas evening next Thursday at 7pm in the lounge. Low-key, bring a small plate to share if you can. Who's down? :tada::question:

ryan: Im in. Can we do 4 rounds of 6 questions each? Keeps it moving. :stopwatch:

olivia: Count me in. I can bring marinated olives and a cheese board.

hassan: In for trivia. Also can DJ a short playlist. Any theme requests? 80s? indie?

emma: Love this. Ill bring a veggie tapas plate (patatas bravas). Can we keep spice level moderate? I have colleagues who avoid spicy food.

maya: Good call on spice. We'll label any spicy items.

ryan: Quick poll for team size — reply with Y to confirm, R if maybe.

olivia: Y

hassan: Y (plus +1?) Might bring my partner, will confirm by Tue.

emma: Y

maya: Y

caterbot: Heads-up: we need to log food brought for allergy tracking. Please add any allergies in replies (nuts, shellfish, gluten, dairy).

ryan: no nuts for me

olivia: dairy allergy (mild), will bring gf crackers for myself

hassan: none

emma: dairy ok, but no shellfish

maya: gluten free option noted — I'll bring a rice-paper roll plate

ryan: Logistics Q: do we have enough folding chairs? Lounge has 8, we might need 4 more.

olivia: Facilities said we can borrow 6 extra from the training room if someone signs off. 

maya: I can swing by training room at 6:30 and bring chairs over.

hassan: I'll bring a small Bluetooth speaker and mic (for dramatic trivia host vibes).

emma: I can print some answer sheets and bring pens.

ryan: I'll be trivia master for round 1 and 2, @hassan you can take round 3, and we can do a lightning bonus round at the end.

olivia: Prize idea? Small trophy? gift card? homemade cookie jar?

emma: How about a $25 coffee shop card + a silly cardboard crown for winners.

maya: Love that. I have a tiny cardboard crown from last year we can reuse.

ryan: RSVP list: maya, ryan, olivia, hassan (maybe +1), emma. If you haven't replied and want in drop a Y.

caterbot: Reminder set: "Weeknight Trivia + Tapas" — reminders 24h and 1h before. Also automated allergy list will be emailed to ops.

olivia: Minor ask: can people bring disposables or BYO plates to reduce washing? I'll bring a stack of compostable plates.

hassan: I'll help clean up afterwards.

emma: Same — happy to help with post-event tidy.

maya: Great team. I'll post a short sign-up with slots for "bring food", "chairs", "setup", "cleanup" tomorrow so we can divvy tasks. See you Thu! :sparkles:
